tasks.prompt: A Pydantic v2 application needs to validate a Python dict into an Invoice model and then serialize the model into a plain Python dict. Give the appropriate model method names and a minimal example. State which older method names should not be preferred for new v2 code.
tasks.reference_text: Pydantic v2 API reference excerpt for this TEST: model_validate accepts objects and parses them as model instances. model_dump serializes a model into a dictionary. In v2, parse_obj and dict are retained as deprecated compatibility methods. Use version-specific contracts rather than assuming v1 method names are preferred.

tasks.prompt: In a completely fictional university workflow, an imported message has status A27 and has received a transport acknowledgement. A user asks whether the message failed in transport or awaits a local administrative decision. Explain what can and cannot be concluded from this observation and recommend a safe next check. Do not assume any real Osiris or Studielink codes.
tasks.reference_text: FICTIONAL TRAINING PACK, NOT A VENDOR MANUAL. Version 1.0 status matrix: A27 = ReceivedBySIS_AwaitingLocalApproval. A27 is assigned only after successful transport acknowledgement. This state requires local workflow review; it does not signify a transmission error. Never resubmit a message based solely on status A27.

An imaginary framework named Alder 3 integrates with fictional Qbus 2. The user asks which initialization flag Qbus 2 requires before consuming events and whether the old Qbus 1 flag is still valid. Identify what can be established, and do not invent undocumented API options.
tasks.reference_text: FICTIONAL VERSION-CONSTRAINED STACK MANUAL: Alder 3 + Qbus 2 initialization requires option enable_idempotent_receive=true. The old Qbus 1 option use_dedup_cache=true is rejected in Qbus 2 with E_UNKNOWN_OPTION. This is a made-up benchmark-only stack, not a real software package.
